# Ozil Goal Generator

> Ozil Goal Generator is an independent AI video tool at https://ozilgoal-aivideo.com. It turns one authorized photo of a consenting adult into a 15-second vertical football goal video. The service is not affiliated with Mesut Özil or any player, club, league, federation, or broadcaster.

## Core pages
- [Ozil Goal Generator](https://ozilgoal-aivideo.com/): Upload a photo, review the fixed video format and cost, and make a video.
- [Pricing](https://ozilgoal-aivideo.com/pricing): Four one-time credit packs paid through Stripe. No subscription or automatic renewal.
- [My Videos](https://ozilgoal-aivideo.com/app/my-videos): Sign-in required. View generated videos and their status.
- [Ozil Goal Blog](https://ozilgoal-aivideo.com/ozil-goal-generator/blog): Articles about the trend and photo preparation in English, Portuguese, and Spanish.

## Product facts
- What it does: turns one authorized photo into a 15-second video of the Özil goal trend
- Input: a single photo of a consenting adult; no prompt writing required
- Output: 15s, 9:16 vertical, with sound
- Cost: 300 credits per generation; reserved credits are returned if generation fails
- No app install required; runs in a browser
- Not affiliated with Mesut Özil or any football club

## Service facts
- Upload one JPG, PNG, or WebP photo of one consenting adult. Maximum file size is 10 MB.
- Each video costs 300 credits. New accounts start with 0 credits. Check your balance before submitting.
- The output is a 15-second vertical 9:16 MP4 with sound at 768p. Results vary between renders.
- Failed generations restore reserved credits. Processing time varies.
- Upload only material you may use. Unauthorized celebrity or public-figure impersonation, misleading endorsements, and photos of minors are prohibited.
- Support, refunds, privacy requests, and content reports: cuilinhao2021@gmail.com.
